document.abstract: This article gives a brief overview of the HMI lighting system used at the new broadcasting studio of the Television lwate Corp. in Japan. The studio has special requirements in that it is full of natural daylight, and it is necessary for the color temperature and illuminance of the lighting equipment chosen to completely match this light. Various kinds of lighting systems are evaluated, and the advantages of the dimmable HMI lighting system now in use are described.
